# Cache plus remote separation (issue #504).
# Every claimed row carries the shared BuildBuddy remote cache plus
# remote evidence (the per-host disk-cache scopes are deleted);
# per-cell coverage never unions across cells. Required native workflows
# are never weakened to obtain a larger cross-build table. Cross-host
# Windows inference stays rejected; weakened native workflows for a
# larger table stay rejected.

shared cache evidence for every claimed row
separate cache and remote evidence for every claimed row
BuildBuddy shared remote cache, no per-host scopes
per-cell coverage with no union
Do not weaken required native workflows to obtain a larger cross-build table
weakened native workflows for a larger table rejected
cross-host Windows inference rejected
pinned upstream toolchains with provisional backends
